fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. With several players the thrower's machine computes its beacon's countdown from its own row (replicated at creation), so every thrower needs the mod.
fields.semantics: The call-in countdown before the delivery starts. The game's upgrades and active mission effects apply on top (the native 120mm 5 s showed 4 s live with ship upgrades); the pod fall, the orbital travel and an aircraft's flight come after it and are not part of it. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +0x54 is code-proven offline as the call-in the beacon countdown adds (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json timing), and every row's value equals the research, but no live write has confirmed the gameplay effect yet.

Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.

fields.writeScope: A type-record write: the record of this Eagle's own jet, read by every call of THIS Eagle stratagem on this machine (all players' calls of it) until it is restored. fields.nativeReader: the approach planner 0x89EF70 (pins 0x89F1A6, 0x89F1B5), read once per call at dispatch, directly from the type record (0x514640 via 0x89EE70)

fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +0x54 is code-proven offline as the call-in the beacon countdown adds (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json timing), and every row's value equals the research, but no live write has confirmed the gameplay effect yet.

fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.

fields.valueSource: The name of a catalogued stratagem (listed in presentationSources.stratagems): the field takes that stratagem's own value, an existing vanilla resource the game keeps loaded. The field's own stratagem name is its native value; setting it back restores the original. Raw localization ids and image hashes are not accepted. presentation_icon also takes the mod's own image, hd2.resources.image(id) (presentationSources.customImages).
fields.applyTiming: Apply aboard the ship, before the mission. The loadout screen reads the row when it builds its widgets (reopen it after a change). The mission HUD builds each slot's visual once per stratagem type: during a mission the menu name follows at once, but the slot keeps its icon until the next mission.

fields.reason: StratagemInfo +80: an integer use count, or 'unlimited' (the native 0xFFFFFFFF value). Eagles use the same field for uses per rearm and are excluded.
fields.provenance: current-build retained snapshot plus schema-labelled native ownership
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +80 is the native mission-use count (0xFFFFFFFF = unlimited, the game's own value for the FRV and most stratagems); only Exosuit 3 -> unlimited is gameplay-proven (reference mod).
fields.caveat: Use counts are applied by the mission host; the HUD counter may keep its old value until the next mission (reference mod observation).

fields.reason: StratagemInfo +0x54: the call-in countdown before the delivery starts, read once when a beacon of this stratagem is created (0x879900). The game's upgrades and mission effects apply on top; the pod fall, the orbital travel and the aircraft's flight are not part of it.
fields.provenance: StratagemInfo +0x54 of the stratagem's own row; native reader 0x879900 (+0x54), called from the beacon initialization 0x6AE7D5 -> 0x6A5B70 (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json)
fields.rangeJustification: 0 to 60 seconds (the longest native call-in is 6 s, the 380mm's; a beacon countdown above 120 s is never set).
fields.readTimingNote: read once when a beacon of this stratagem is created: applies to beacons thrown after the write; a beacon already thrown keeps its countdown
fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. With several players the thrower's machine computes its beacon's countdown from its own row (replicated at creation), so every thrower needs the mod.
fields.semantics: The call-in countdown before the delivery starts. The game's upgrades and active mission effects apply on top (the native 120mm 5 s showed 4 s live with ship upgrades); the pod fall, the orbital travel and an aircraft's flight come after it and are not part of it. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +0x54 is code-proven offline as the call-in the beacon countdown adds (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json timing), and every row's value equals the research, but no live write has confirmed the gameplay effect yet.

fields.reason: StratagemInfo +80: an integer use count, or 'unlimited' (the native 0xFFFFFFFF value). Eagles use the same field for uses per rearm and are excluded.
fields.provenance: current-build retained snapshot plus schema-labelled native ownership
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +80 is the native mission-use count (0xFFFFFFFF = unlimited, the game's own value for the FRV and most stratagems); only Exosuit 3 -> unlimited is gameplay-proven (reference mod).
fields.caveat: Use counts are applied by the mission host; the HUD counter may keep its old value until the next mission (reference mod observation).

fields.reason: StratagemInfo +0x54: the call-in countdown before the delivery starts, read once when a beacon of this stratagem is created (0x879900). The game's upgrades and mission effects apply on top; the pod fall, the orbital travel and the aircraft's flight are not part of it.
fields.provenance: StratagemInfo +0x54 of the stratagem's own row; native reader 0x879900 (+0x54), called from the beacon initialization 0x6AE7D5 -> 0x6A5B70 (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json)
fields.rangeJustification: 0 to 60 seconds (the longest native call-in is 6 s, the 380mm's; a beacon countdown above 120 s is never set).
fields.readTimingNote: read once when a beacon of this stratagem is created: applies to beacons thrown after the write; a beacon already thrown keeps its countdown
fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. With several players the thrower's machine computes its beacon's countdown from its own row (replicated at creation), so every thrower needs the mod.
fields.semantics: The call-in countdown before the delivery starts. The game's upgrades and active mission effects apply on top (the native 120mm 5 s showed 4 s live with ship upgrades); the pod fall, the orbital travel and an aircraft's flight come after it and are not part of it. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +0x54 is code-proven offline as the call-in the beacon countdown adds (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json timing), and every row's value equals the research, but no live write has confirmed the gameplay effect yet.

fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.

fields.provenance: StratagemInfo +0x54 of the stratagem's own row; native reader 0x879900 (+0x54), called from the beacon initialization 0x6AE7D5 -> 0x6A5B70 (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json)
fields.rangeJustification: 0 to 60 seconds (the longest native call-in is 6 s, the 380mm's; a beacon countdown above 120 s is never set).
fields.readTimingNote: read once when a beacon of this stratagem is created: applies to beacons thrown after the write; a beacon already thrown keeps its countdown
fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. With several players the thrower's machine computes its beacon's countdown from its own row (replicated at creation), so every thrower needs the mod.
fields.semantics: The call-in countdown before the delivery starts. The game's upgrades and active mission effects apply on top (the native 120mm 5 s showed 4 s live with ship upgrades); the pod fall, the orbital travel and an aircraft's flight come after it and are not part of it. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +0x54 is code-proven offline as the call-in the beacon countdown adds (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json timing), and every row's value equals the research, but no live write has confirmed the gameplay effect yet.

fields.acknowledgementReason: Wind-up (the firing charge, WeaponHeat +148/+152/+156/+160; typed FP32/FP32/FP32/UINT8): the weapon fires only once its charge reaches heat.firing_charge; holding the trigger adds heat.charge_gain_per_second per second, releasing it removes heat.charge_loss_per_second per second, and heat.reset_charge_after_shot empties it after every shot (the Quasar). Live test pending: Sickle 0 fires at once, 400 winds up about 2 s.

fields.writeScope: A type-record write: this stratagem's own StratagemInfo row, read by every beacon of it created on this machine until it is restored. With several players the thrower's machine computes its beacon's countdown from its own row (replicated at creation), so every thrower needs the mod.
fields.semantics: The call-in countdown before the delivery starts. The game's upgrades and active mission effects apply on top (the native 120mm 5 s showed 4 s live with ship upgrades); the pod fall, the orbital travel and an aircraft's flight come after it and are not part of it. Eagles are 0: their delay is the jet's flight.
fields.acknowledgementReason: StratagemInfo +0x54 is code-proven offline as the call-in the beacon countdown adds (research/beacon-redirect-F5FEE03DCFDB.json timing), and every row's value equals the research, but no live write has confirmed the gameplay effect yet.

fields.hudSynchronization: The HUD stratagem list draws a slot's arrows once. Whenever Runtime changes or restores the code, it redraws only that stratagem's slot with the game's own arrow data once the slot exists (once per change, never every frame). minefield.proof: Six salvos of eight mines are deployed, totaling up to forty-eight
minefield.increase: blocked: the launcher has one launch socket per mine, so more mines than sockets would need nodes the model does not have
minefield.deploymentPattern: Salvos are sequential launcher sweeps over different rotational sectors; reducing the count truncates the angular deployment (fewer sectors covered), it does not thin mines evenly around 360 degrees.

fields.hudSynchronization: The HUD stratagem list draws a slot's arrows once. Whenever Runtime changes or restores the code, it redraws only that stratagem's slot with the game's own arrow data once the slot exists (once per change, never every frame). A refused redraw leaves the code applied and is retried.
fields.acknowledgementRule: A code equal to another stratagem's native code requires allow_unverified_effect: which stratagem the game calls for two equal codes is not proven.
